content: कुमुदः, -दम् [कौ भोदते इति कुमुदम्] .²1 The white water-lily said to open at moon-rise [Nymphea alba] नोच्छ्वसिति तपनकिरणैश्चन्द्रस्येवांशुभिः कुमुदम् <ls>V. 3. 16</ls>; so <ls>Ś. 5. 28</ls>; <ls>Ṛs. 3. 2</ls>, <ls n="Ṛs. 3.">21</ls>, <ls n="Ṛs. 3.">23</ls>; <ls>Me. 42</ls>. कुमुदवनमपश्रि श्रीमदम्भोजषण्डम् <ls>Śi. 11. 64</ls>. .²2 A red lotus. .{@-दम्@} Silver. .{@-दः@} .²1 An epithet of Viṣṇu. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of the elephant supposed to guard the south. .²3 Camphor. .²4 A species of monkey. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of a Nāga who gave his younger sister कुमुद्वती to Kuśa, son of Rāma; see <ls>R. 16. 79</ls>, <ls n="R. 16.">86</ls>. .{@-दा@} A form of Durgā.
